warnings: the canary is an over-privileged CALLER, not a deployed broken function: it proves the detector can see tenant data in a response, not that a subtle authorization bug would be caught. A deployed canary is gated on Andrew — ROADMAP 0.6.

public by design, measured rather than assumed: an ANONYMOUS caller holding a booking's UUID moved bookings, campaign_visits, email_sends on the twin tenant. That is the UUID-bearer model cancel-booking and reschedule-booking are built on — the emailed link is the credential. It is not a tenant leak, and it is worth knowing that the UUID is the only thing protecting those rows.
